project.name: 2026世界杯淘汰赛
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Dark stadium atmosphere with championship gold (#d4a017) and crimson red (#dc2626) accents. Oswald display font for impact headlines, Inter for body. High contrast, intense competitive energy. Cards with gold border glow on hover.
project.designRead: Sports event knockout stage / passionate football fans / competitive intensity dark premium / medium density / avoid purple neon AI hero

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: Championship gold for CTAs, highlights, and winner indicators
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: Single gold primary + crimson accent for alerts/live indicators only
colorSystem.stateColors: success=green for match completed, warning=gold for upcoming, error=red for live

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Rounded but tight: sm=4px, md=8px, lg=12px, full=9999px
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Oswald for display/headlines, Inter + Noto Sans SC for body text
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: Dark cards with subtle borders, gold glow hover, badge-style status indicators
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Border-first surfaces, shadow alpha <= 0.05 for static, deeper for floating layers
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Sports photography with gold/amber overlay treatment
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Energetic, competitive - urgent red for live, gold for upcoming

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: Dark top navbar with gold logo, horizontal nav links, gold active indicator underline
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: Gold primary for CTAs and highlights, crimson for live/urgent states
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Oswald display + Inter body, Chinese fallback to Noto Sans SC
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: 4/8/12px tiers, full for pills and badges
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: Dark elevated cards with border, gold glow on hover
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: Gold-filled buttons with dark text, red-outlined for secondary
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: Center-aligned hero, grid-based content sections, left-aligned text blocks

privateRegions: hero section, news section, teams grid, quick nav
16 team cards with flags and info

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Dark stadium theme with gold championship accents, Oswald display font, competitive intensity tone

pages.title: 淘汰赛首页
pages.businessScenario: Knockout stage landing page with hero, latest news, advancing teams, and quick navigation
pages.visualNorthStar: A dramatic dark stadium atmosphere with gold championship accents - the hero feels like walking into a packed arena under floodlights
pages.compositionPattern: Hero + Feature Grid + Card List pattern

pages.title: 淘汰赛对阵图
pages.businessScenario: Tournament bracket visualization showing all 16 teams and their knockout matchups
pages.visualNorthStar: A clean, readable tournament tree diagram on dark background - gold lines connecting matchups, teams as flag+name badges, clear progression from left to right
qualityRisks: complex bracket layout needs careful responsive handling

pages.title: 淘汰赛赛程
pages.businessScenario: Detailed match schedule for all knockout rounds with dates, venues, and status indicators
pages.visualNorthStar: A timeline-style schedule with round filters - upcoming matches glow gold, live matches pulse red, completed matches show results in muted tone

pages.title: 16强球队巡礼
pages.businessScenario: Showcase all 16 advancing teams with flags, group performance, key players, and knockout prospects
pages.visualNorthStar: A dramatic team gallery - each team card has a large flag, country name in Oswald, group stage stats, and a gold badge showing their group ranking
qualityRisks: 16 team cards need balanced grid layout

assets.semanticDescription: Dramatic stadium atmosphere for knockout stage hero section
